data.title: RDGA Registration Timing Pattern Detection
data.description: Detects clusters of domain registrations exhibiting algorithmically regular timing intervals in zone file diffs, a hallmark of Registered Domain Generation Algorithm (RDGA) infrastructure provisioning. Legitimate bulk registrations by brand protection services or hosting providers typically show irregular, human-driven timing patterns. RDGA tooling operates programmatically, producing registration bursts with low standard deviation in inter-registration intervals. This rule alerts when a cluster of newly registered domains exceeds a size threshold and the inter-registration timing standard deviation falls below a regularity threshold, indicating automated generation. Supports TP-0041 Phase 2 detection of RDGA-based initial access infrastructure staging.
falsepositives: Brand protection services registering defensive domains in automated batches
Large hosting providers onboarding customer domains via API
Domain portfolio companies performing scheduled bulk acquisitions
